rows.quote: Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them.
rows.reason_zh: A杖让幻象分别攻击途经的敌人，冲锋本身没有对这些敌人造成范围伤害。

rows.quote: max_distance.scepter: 575→525
rows.reason_zh: 材料只给出A杖冲锋距离的变化，缺少独立确认基础技能可被破坏所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range
rows.reason_zh: 此处的 charges 描述向攻击目标冲锋，说明中没有使用一次便消耗一点的充能。

rows.quote: gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
rows.reason_zh: 基础冲锋仍为幻影长矛手提供闪避。

rows.quote: gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
rows.reason_zh: 基础冲锋仍提升幻影长矛手自身的移动速度。

rows.quote: Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them.
rows.reason_zh: A杖冲锋距离缩短后，穿过敌人仍会制造幻象。

rows.quote: Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range
rows.reason_zh: 幻影长矛手会冲向攻击目标，进入攻击距离。

rows.quote: Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range
rows.reason_zh: 说明确认了冲锋位移，但没有交代冲锋能否穿过树木和悬崖。

rows.quote: summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
rows.reason_zh: 基础灵魂之矛会制造一个攻击目标的幻象。

rows.quote: a target enemy unit that damages and slows
rows.reason_zh: 基础灵魂之矛仍对命中的敌方目标施加减速。

rows.quote: summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
rows.reason_zh: 说明将产生的单位明确称为幻象，没有另外召唤或控制其他单位。

rows.quote: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 施法时可以直接选择一个敌方单位作为目标。

rows.quote: Gives %phase_movement_speed%%% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and %phase_movement_speed_range%%% on ranged heroes
rows.reason_zh: 主动相位仍为近战和远程英雄加速，装备的常驻移速加成也分别为55和45。

rows.quote: lets you move through units and turn more quickly for %phase_duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 开启相位后，持有者仍能穿过其他单位。

rows.quote: The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放的光束仍能灼伤其范围内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
rows.reason_zh: 说明写的是凤凰受控会中止光束，没有赋予光束打断敌方持续施法的效果。

rows.quote: heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health.
rows.reason_zh: 光束仍按基础值和友军最大生命值的一定比例治疗友军。

rows.quote: Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
rows.reason_zh: 沉默是凤凰受到后会中止光束的控制，光束没有对敌人施加沉默。

rows.quote: Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
rows.reason_zh: 睡眠是中止凤凰光束的外部控制，光束没有使目标入睡。

rows.quote: Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
rows.reason_zh: 眩晕会使凤凰中止光束，说明没有赋予光束眩晕敌人的效果。

rows.quote: Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area.
rows.reason_zh: 烈日仍能灼伤大范围内的多个敌人。

rows.quote: DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能明确标注施加强驱散。

rows.quote: Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area.
rows.reason_zh: 持续灼烧以凤凰化成的烈日为中心，作用于周围敌人。

rows.quote: restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.
rows.reason_zh: 烈日成功爆炸时会刷新凤凰的技能冷却。

rows.quote: restoring Phoenix to full health and mana
rows.reason_zh: 烈日成功爆炸时会回满凤凰的生命值。

rows.quote: restoring Phoenix to full health and mana
rows.reason_zh: 烈日成功爆炸时会回满凤凰自身的法力值。

rows.quote: The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能仍让凤凰有机会在烈日存续至结束时重生。

rows.quote: allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.
rows.reason_zh: A杖仍允许凤凰带一名友方英雄进入烈日并一同重生。

rows.quote: the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies
rows.reason_zh: 烈日爆炸仍会眩晕周围所有敌人，调整后的各级眩晕时长都大于零。

new_mechanisms.quote: The sun has pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the sun.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42为烈日的格数生命加入了来源限定的减伤规则，小兵和幻象对烈日只造成25%的伤害。

rows.quote: deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them
rows.reason_zh: 说明和变更字段只涉及被动的伤害、减速与冷却，缺少可核实装备生命回复的属性值。

rows.quote: deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them
rows.reason_zh: 被动说明没有回蓝效果，材料也没有提供装备的法力回复属性值。

rows.quote: slow: 30→40；slow_duration: 3→2
rows.reason_zh: 触发后的减速从30%提高到40%，持续时间从3秒缩短到2秒。

rows.quote: deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target
rows.reason_zh: 灵匣独立结算一段额外伤害，没有提高触发技能本身的伤害。

rows.quote: Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_block% damage to all nearby allies.
rows.reason_zh: 主动范围效果为附近友军吸收伤害，没有对范围内敌人造成伤害。

rows.quote: Passive: Insight Aura Gives allied units %magic_resistance_aura%%% magic resistance. Radius: %aura_radius%
rows.reason_zh: 洞察光环仍为持有者周围的友方单位提供魔法抗性。

rows.quote: Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_block% damage to all nearby allies.
rows.reason_zh: 主动护盾仍能为附近友军吸收魔法伤害。

rows.quote: Passive: Insight Aura Gives allied units %magic_resistance_aura%%% magic resistance.
rows.reason_zh: 光环说明只列出魔抗，所给字段也不足以确认装备是否另有生命回复属性。

new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42将烟斗效果的驱散属性从0改为2，材料未提供数值与具体驱散等级的对照。

rows.quote: bonus_movement_speed_melee.base: null→55；bonus_movement_speed_ranged.base: null→45
rows.reason_zh: 7.42的装备字段明确给近战持有者增加55移速、远程持有者增加45移速。

rows.quote: Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns enemies and deals %base_damage% + %damage_str_pct%%% STR damage.
rows.reason_zh: 投向目标地点的岩石仍可伤害多个敌人，力量加成只改变伤害计算。

rows.quote: After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.
rows.reason_zh: 碎片由技能投出的岩石落地后产生，没有让普通攻击溅射。

rows.quote: throws a rock at the target location that stuns enemies
rows.reason_zh: 投石仍会眩晕命中的敌人。

rows.quote: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate.
rows.reason_zh: 有A杖时，一次梦境缠绕能让所有受影响的敌人受到攻击。

rows.quote: latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能一次可连接并伤害多名敌方英雄。

rows.quote: it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
rows.reason_zh: 挣断连接会另外造成一次伤害，没有提高目标受到的物理或全部伤害。

rows.quote: latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.
rows.reason_zh: 基础技能明确对连接的敌方英雄施加束缚。

rows.quote: If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps
rows.reason_zh: 受影响的敌人仍能走动，甚至可以走远并挣断连接。

rows.quote: The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
rows.reason_zh: A杖目标仍可移动并挣断连接，升级只让攻击在断裂眩晕期间继续。

rows.quote: it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
rows.reason_zh: 敌人移动过远使连接断裂时仍会受到眩晕。

rows.quote: a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
rows.reason_zh: 一次施放仍能对落点附近的多个敌方单位造成伤害。

rows.quote: Puck teleports to the target location
rows.reason_zh: 帕克自身仍会传送到目标地点。

rows.quote: silences enemy units nearby.
rows.reason_zh: 新月之痕仍会沉默附近的敌方单位。

rows.quote: Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time.
rows.reason_zh: 肢解的持续伤害作用于被咬住的单个敌方单位。

rows.quote: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 技能仍明确标注为持续施法。

rows.quote: Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units
rows.reason_zh: 帕吉仍会把被肢解的单位拉向自己。

rows.quote: Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount.
rows.reason_zh: 肢解造成伤害时仍会为帕吉恢复生命值。

rows.quote: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
rows.reason_zh: 说明只交代目标中途隐身后肢解仍会生效，没有赋予肢解使单位隐身的能力。

rows.quote: Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount.
rows.reason_zh: 帕吉按肢解造成的伤害全额恢复自身生命，符合技能吸血的定义。

rows.quote: Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time.
rows.reason_zh: 肢解期间目标仍被持续控制而无法行动，本次调整只涉及力量伤害系数。

rows.quote: Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it
rows.reason_zh: 肢解仍以一个敌方单位为施法目标。

rows.quote: The hook will snag the first unit it encounters
rows.reason_zh: 基础肉钩只钩住遇到的第一个单位，单次命中没有范围伤害。

rows.quote: When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶的距离加成伤害仍只结算给被钩中的敌人。

rows.quote: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
rows.reason_zh: 基础肉钩明确会打断敌方主目标的持续施法。

rows.quote: Increases range. When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.
rows.reason_zh: 拉回目标由基础肉钩提供，魔晶只增加射程并按拉动距离附加伤害。

rows.quote: dragging the unit back to Pudge
rows.reason_zh: 基础肉钩会把钩中的单位拉回帕吉身边。

rows.quote: Meat Hook hits invisible units.
rows.reason_zh: 肉钩可以命中已经隐身的单位，没有使单位隐身的效果。

rows.quote: Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
rows.reason_zh: 可以穿过树木的是飞出的钩子，帕吉自身没有获得穿树移动能力。

rows.quote: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked.
rows.reason_zh: 衰老对一个单位施加状态，说明没有范围伤害效果。

rows.quote: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
rows.reason_zh: 受影响单位仍在场且能受到魔法和纯粹伤害，不符合放逐所需的离场状态。

rows.quote: renders it unable to attack or be attacked.
rows.reason_zh: 目标无法攻击或被攻击，同时仍可受到魔法和纯粹伤害，符合虚无的定义。

rows.quote: Healing received and dealt by affected allies is increased
rows.reason_zh: 衰老提高友军接受和施加的治疗量，技能本身没有直接恢复生命。

rows.quote: afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
rows.reason_zh: 敌方目标的易伤只适用于魔法伤害，没有扩大到物理或全部伤害。

rows.quote: afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
rows.reason_zh: 7.42仍明确规定受影响的敌人承受额外魔法伤害。

rows.quote: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit
rows.reason_zh: 衰老仍能减慢敌方目标，备注明确排除了友方单位。

rows.quote: slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing received and dealt by affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
rows.reason_zh: 衰老对一个选定单位施放，允许选择敌方目标。

rows.quote: causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward
rows.reason_zh: 魔晶仍允许一次生命汲取经守卫折射到范围内所有敌方英雄。

rows.quote: The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
rows.reason_zh: 守卫被摧毁会中止折射效果，魔晶没有打断敌方持续施法的效果。

rows.quote: channel_times: [10]→[0]；AbilityChannelTime.base: [10]→null；durations: [0]→[10]
rows.reason_zh: 英文说明仍标注 CHANNELED，但按字段优先规则，原10秒引导已改为10秒效果持续时间。

rows.quote: granting vision over the target.
rows.reason_zh: 对敌方施放仍会提供目标的视野。

rows.quote: When cast on an ally, Pugna heals his ally and takes magical damage equal to the amount healed.
rows.reason_zh: 对友军施放仍会治疗该友军，对敌人施放也仍能治疗帕格纳自身。

rows.quote: healing himself for the damage dealt
rows.reason_zh: 对敌施放时，帕格纳按实际造成的伤害恢复自身生命。

rows.quote: ability_has_scepter: true→false；max_spell_amp_drain_pct.scepter: [100]→null
rows.reason_zh: 生命汲取的A杖升级及其法术放大汲取字段均已移除。

rows.quote: When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit
rows.reason_zh: 生命汲取仍可直接选择一个敌方单位施放。

new_mechanisms.quote: When cast on an ally, Pugna heals his ally and takes magical damage equal to the amount healed. This damage cannot kill Pugna.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 7.42将对友军施放时的自身生命消耗明确改为等同治疗量的非致死魔法伤害，承伤者是帕格纳自己。

rows.quote: ability_has_scepter: false→true
rows.reason_zh: 新增A杖升级不能确定基础技能能否被破坏，材料没有提供 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Pugna receives %tower_scale%%% spell amplification per destroyed tower.
rows.reason_zh: 每座被摧毁的塔仍会为帕格纳提供基础技能自带的法术放大。

new_mechanisms.quote: Pugna can cast any of his abilities an additional time, consuming an Oblivion Savant charge instead.
new_mechanisms.reason_zh: 新增A杖升级提供2点充能，每额外施放一次技能消耗1点，充能恢复时间为20秒。

rows.quote: The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 一次尖叫能伤害痛苦女王周围的多个敌人。

rows.quote: %damage_reflected_to_self%%% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
rows.reason_zh: 伤害由痛苦女王主动击中英雄后回到自身，没有在她受击时触发对外反击。

rows.quote: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
rows.reason_zh: 尖叫能命中隐身单位，没有使任何单位隐身。

rows.quote: Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
rows.reason_zh: A杖仍将暗影突袭改为范围技能，并使目标在效果结束或被重新施加时发出范围尖叫。

rows.quote: The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 中毒目标仍会受到移动减速，持续时间从16秒缩短到13秒。

rows.quote: The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.
rows.reason_zh: 基础毒镖仍作用于选定的单个敌人，本次只调整持续时间和持续伤害。

rows.quote: dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake
rows.reason_zh: 冲击波仍能伤害路径上的所有敌方单位。

rows.quote: all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
rows.reason_zh: 冲击波仍会将命中的敌方单位向后推。

rows.quote: spell_lifesteal: 2→3；spell_lifesteal_close: 14→17
rows.reason_zh: 这两个字段只说明吸血数值提高，材料没有提供判定可破坏性所需的 IsBreakable 值。

rows.quote: Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies.
rows.reason_zh: 痛苦女王仍获得随敌我距离缩短而增强的技能吸血，基础值和近距离值均有所提高。
